headline: Kroger (KR) Launches GLP 1 Support Program For Weight Management Patients
summary: Kroger Health, a division of Kroger (NYSE:KR), launched its GLP-1 Complete Support Program for weight management. The program offers patients access to pharmacists, dietitians, clinical services, and pharmacy affordability options. The initiative focuses on people using GLP-1 medications and aims to integrate guidance on treatment, nutrition, and cost support. headline: Five Ways to Get the Most from a GLP-1 Medication
summary: GLP-1 medications are changing what is possible for many patients looking to manage their weight. To get the most out of this treatment, patients need more than a prescription.
